findings.plain_summary: OPM finalized a rule removing the governmentwide 52-week time-in-grade restriction for promotions to covered competitive-service GS-6 and above positions, effective January 14, 2027. Agencies can still set job-related prerequisites, including time in grade, through written merit-promotion plans, and the rule also makes related changes to student appointment, training, and other personnel regulations.

items.headline: Agencies may keep their own time-in-grade requirements
items.what_changes: The governmentwide 52-week rule is removed, but each agency may still impose a period of service in grade through its written merit-promotion plan if the requirement is job-related and consistently applied. Waiting periods could therefore persist at the agency level.
items.speaker: OPM
items.quote: Agencies may continue to establish job-related promotion prerequisites, including a period of service in grade, through their written merit-promotion plans, provided those requirements are consistently applied.

items.headline: Rule also changes student appointment, training, and other personnel regulations
items.what_changes: Beyond time-in-grade, the final rule amends regulations on student appointments, training, and unspecified 'other personnel matters.' The release gives no detail on what these changes are.
items.speaker: OPM
items.quote: It also makes related changes to regulations governing student appointments, training, and other personnel matters.

items.headline: Effective date is January 14, 2027
items.what_changes: The rule takes effect roughly three months after the release date; agencies must adapt merit-promotion plans and practices by then.
items.speaker: OPM

items.headline: No promotion guarantee; qualification standards and competitive procedures unchanged
items.what_changes: Removing the restriction only makes employees eligible for consideration sooner. It does not waive qualification standards or alter competitive procedures for evaluating and selecting candidates.
items.speaker: OPM
items.quote: It does not guarantee a promotion, waive qualification standards, or change the competitive procedures agencies use to evaluate and select candidates.

items.headline: Scope limited to covered competitive-service GS-6 and above positions
items.what_changes: The removal applies to advancement to covered competitive-service General Schedule positions at GS-6 and above, not to all federal positions or lower grades.
items.speaker: OPM
items.quote: has finalized a rule removing the governmentwide time-in-grade restriction for advancement to covered competitive-service General Schedule positions at GS-6 and above.

could_not_determine: How many employees or positions are affected by the removal of the time-in-grade restriction
The cost, savings, or other regulatory impact analysis for the rule
Whether public comments were received on the proposal, how many, and how OPM responded
What the specific related changes to student appointments, training, and other personnel matters are
Which positions are 'covered' beyond competitive-service GS-6 and above, and whether any exceptions remain
The CFR sections amended and the regulatory text itself
How agencies must document or apply any time-in-grade requirements in merit-promotion plans, or whether there is a transition period

doc.title: OPM Finalizes Rule Removing Governmentwide Time-in-Grade Barrier to Promotions
